 Big Story Features Delhi Bengal Nation Opinion Editorial World Business Sports Entertainment Sponsored All Authors Home >  Entertainment >  Raveena Tandon recalls the difficult shoot of ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ Entertainment Raveena Tandon recalls the difficult shoot of ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ 
 BY  Agencies 9 Nov 2026 9:49 PM IST X Agencies 9 Nov 2026 9:49 PM IST 
 Raveena Tandon shared some interesting memories from the shoot of her hit song ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’, revealing how difficult it was to film the iconic rain sequence.
 During a conversation with Madhuri Dixit on the reality quiz show ‘Kon Honar Crorepati’, Raveena revealed that the song was shot over three days. She had to work for 12 hours each day while dancing in extremely cold water.
 The song became one of the most popular rain sequences in Hindi cinema. It required Raveena to perform several dance steps while being drenched under artificial rain. Talking about the shoot, Raveena said that songs often took several days to film back then, so completing ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ in three days was relatively quick. However, the cold water made the experience difficult.
 She also explained that the water used for rain sequences was stored in tankers for several days before being brought to the sets. By the time it was sprayed on the actors, the water had become extremely cold.
 Madhuri, who has also filmed several memorable rain sequences, agreed with Raveena and recalled how actors would try to keep themselves warm between takes.
 “After the shot, we would sit there soaking wet, wrapped in a towel and shivering. Just as we started to warm up a little, they’d call us for the next shot. Then it was cold water all over again and we had to act and lip-sync while shivering,” Madhuri recalled.
 The ‘Patthar Ke Phool’ actress also spoke about the hectic work schedules actors followed during the peak of their careers. She recalled a time when she was shooting for nearly 30 films in a year, often moving from one set straight to another. She remembered working from 7 am to 2 pm, followed by another shift from 2 pm until 7 am the next morning. She would then head directly to another set. With such demanding schedules, she barely had time to go home, freshen up and change before resuming work.
 ‘Tip Tip Barsa Paani’ remains one of Raveena’s most memorable screen appearances. The song featured her alongside Akshay Kumar in the 1994 action-drama ‘Mohra’, directed by Rajiv Rai.
